## Structured Error Envelope

- [x] CHK001 Are structured JSON result requirements explicit for every mode and failure class, including `schema_version`, `ok`, `entrypoint`, `mode`, `status`, `code`, `mutation_status`, `config`, `target`, `evidence`, `errors`, `snapshot_before`, `snapshot_after`, `redaction`, `action_required`, and `exit_code`? - [x] CHK002 Are stable error codes specified for config shape, product-line identity, GitHub ownership, workflow contract, feature flag, agent assignment, governance, existing-target, mutation, verify, CLI, and unexpected boundary failures? [Completeness, Spec §SC-006, Contract §Validation Error Codes]
- [x] CHK003 Are config path and field-name requirements clear enough for validation errors to identify the offending YAML location without relying on free-form messages? [Clarity, Spec §US4-AC1, §SC-006, Contract §Validation Error Codes]
- [x] CHK004 Are failure statuses and exit codes measurable for blocked/refusal, workflow-contract-not-ready, verify drift, CLI usage, and unexpected boundary errors? [Measurability, Spec §FR-015, Contract §Exit Codes]
- [x] CHK005 Are `status`, `code`, and `mutation_status` requirements consistent across existing-target refusal, blocked preflight, validation failure, contract-not-ready, verification failure, and CLI error cases? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, Contract §Required Statuses]

## Fail-Closed Validation Coverage

- [x] CHK006 Are missing identity, missing ownership, unsupported fields, duplicate declarations, conflicting declarations, and invalid field types required to fail before any write-capable mutation? [Coverage, Spec §US4-AC1, §FR-005, §FR-014, §SC-006]
- [x] CHK007 Are missing, ambiguous, inapplicable, unreadable, or unsupported workflow contract family/path/slug failures specified with stable codes and pre-write failure behavior? [Coverage, Spec §US4-AC3, §FR-007, Contract §Workflow Codes]
- [x] CHK008 Are unknown, duplicated, conflicting, cascade-blocked, env-force-off, and reserved-future feature flag failures defined as pre-write failures with explicit registry and reserved-flag rules? [Coverage, Spec §US4-AC2, §FR-008, §FR-009, §FR-010, Contract §Feature Flag Codes]

- [x] CHK010 Are target residue and conflicting repository/product-line ownership failures required to block without automatic deletion, unlinking, or cleanup mutation? [Consistency, Spec §US4-AC5, §FR-006, §FR-027, Contract §Product-Line And GitHub Codes]
- [x] CHK011 Are existing-target apply failures without `--allow-existing` specified with a stable refusal envelope, `EXISTING_TARGET_REQUIRES_ALLOW_EXISTING`, `mutation_status:"not_mutated"`, and `action_required:"--allow-existing"`? ## Redaction And Sensitive Evidence

- [x] CHK013 Are structured failure and residue evidence requirements explicit that credentials, tokens, passwords, raw secret values, signed URLs, raw logs, raw untrusted payloads, and matched secret substrings are never emitted? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, Constitution §XIII]
- [x] CHK014 Are redaction proof fields measurable, including `raw_secret_values_emitted:false`, `redacted_fields`, stable IDs or counts, rule IDs, hashes, and field paths? [Measurability, Spec §FR-016, Key Entity §Target Residue Evidence]
- [x] CHK015 Are operator evidence and target residue outputs required to remain actionable through redacted cleanup context without exposing raw sensitive or untrusted content? [Clarity, Spec §US4-AC5, §FR-016, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [x] CHK016 Are no-mutation snapshot requirements consistent with redaction constraints so hashes and evidence do not hash or emit raw secrets, logs, signed URLs, raw untrusted payloads, or matched secret substrings? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016, §FR-017, Contract §Snapshot Format]

## Transaction And No-Mutation Boundaries

- [x] CHK017 Are validation and conflict preflight requirements clear that failure occurs before opening a write transaction? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK018 Are apply-mode requirements bounded to one transaction so partial writes are impossible for successful config-owned mutation attempts and transaction failure reports no partial success? [Completeness, Plan §Technical Context, Contract §Existing Target And Mutation Codes]
- [x] CHK019 Are invalid-config and blocked-preflight no-mutation proofs measurable through before/after snapshots over config-owned seed surfaces plus every preserved FR-020 operational/history surface and invariant? [Measurability, Spec §FR-017, §FR-020, §SC-007, Contract §Snapshot Format]
- [x] CHK020 Are requirements explicit that invalid-config or blocked-preflight proof must not use a dry-run/import path that persists diagnostics before snapshots are compared? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK021 Are verify-mode drift and matching scenarios specified as read-only, with drift reported through stable evidence and no existing-target write flag requirement? [Coverage, Spec §FR-021, §SC-010, Contract §Required Statuses]
- [x] CHK022 Are existing-target `--allow-existing` requirements clear that only reviewed config-owned fields can change while non-config-owned operational and history state is preserved? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019, §FR-020, §SC-009]
